verdict.rationale: Turso documents its own ability to delete data: per-user and per-agent databases can be torn down via the Platform API. Customers can also keep data in their own S3 buckets, which gives some control over where retained data lives. However, nothing in the evidence describes configurable retention windows (e.g., for PITR history or backups), deletion guarantees, or purge of replicas and backups. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods for PITR and backups, documented deletion semantics and guarantees covering backups and replicas, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Each entity gets its own isolated SQLite database that you create, token-scope, and tear down via the API.
Pro and Enterprise customers can use their own S3 / S3-express buckets, guaranteeing that data lives inside their infrastructure.
